company.name: Stryde
company.shortDescription: Stryde is on a mission to democratise access to the world of Private Equity and Venture Capital
company.description: Stryde is a digital platform leading a new era of investing. We enable individuals and institutions to access exclusive, high-potential investment opportunities across global sports and entertainment. We exist to inspire better investments and open the door to higher returns for more people. Investors can easily sign up to our platform to access top-tier investment opportunities, expert knowledge, curation and higher returns at lower entry points. For us, service is key. Our team of industry insiders makes sure that we meet every investor with a commitment to knowledge sharing, transparency and ease of investing. Stryde curates a diversified portfolio of opportunities across varying stages, ranging from established teams, leagues and funds for those seeking stability to more emerging sports and new leagues suitable for growth-focused investors.

productsAndServices.description: A platform enabling investment in global sports and entertainment assets, providing access to private equity and venture capital opportunities in these sectors.
